mechanism: ACE inhibitors may potentiate the hypotensive effects of levodopa, and there is potential for reduced antiparkinsonian efficacy; additionally, NSAIDs used concurrently with ACE inhibitors and levodopa can further complicate blood pressure and renal function.
action: Monitor blood pressure closely during concurrent use; adjust levodopa dosing if hypotension or reduced efficacy occurs; counsel patient on orthostatic precautions.
